## Closed beta release

**Version:** 0.2.0-beta.1

### What's included
- Device Owner peel mode with desktop-only control
- Blocked URLs (Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet)
- Hard-block feed apps (YouTube, Instagram, etc.) when peeled
- Delayed unpeel timer
- In-app + companion setup guides

### Tester package
1. Download **`onionpeel-0.2.0-beta.1.apk`** below
2. Clone this repo (or download ZIP) for the **`companion/`** folder
3. Read **[BETA.md](https://github.com/bropunzal/onionpeel/blob/main/BETA.md)** — factory reset required

### Quick companion start
```powershell
cd companion
npm install
copy .env.example .env   # optional: set ONIONPEEL_TOKEN
npm start
```
